landing.heroSubheadline: GrainLedger records the mass flow from smallholder paddy to export container in an append-only custody ledger — so your team can prove provenance, pass MRL checks, and trace any container back to its source plots.

corePromises.title: Three Pillars of the GrainLedger Platform
corePromises.col1Desc: Every drying, milling, fraction separation, and blending conversion enforces mass conservation within strict tolerance. Imbalance is rejected outright, never warned about.
corePromises.col2Desc: From adverse lab results forward to affected shipping containers, and from export containers backward to exact contributing smallholder plots.
corePromises.col3Desc: Supports EU (EC 396/2005), USA (EPA 40 CFR), Japan (MHLW/CAA), Korea, Codex, and Vietnam standards with conservative 95th-percentile bounds and safety margins.

audiences.title: Who uses GrainLedger?
audiences.millDesc: Provides drying, silo storage, milling, and bagging services across multiple customer companies while maintaining strict lot and financial custody separation.
audiences.customerDesc: Isolates company inventory. Manages smallholder farmer intake, field spray declarations, and blend planning prior to export container loading.
audiences.complianceDesc: Monitors substance residue limits, enforces immediate quarantine HOLD orders, and generates immutable compliance dossiers for customs inspection.

howItWorks.title: Mass Journey: 5 Controlled Steps
howItWorks.step1Desc: Weigh fresh paddy at the farm gate, record moisture and coordinates with offline-capable mobile capture.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Intake into the mill, dry down to 14% safe moisture, record moisture loss exactly, and transfer into segregated silos.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Fractionate into head rice, broken rice, bran, and husk while propagating active substance processing factors.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Algorithm proposes blend formulations satisfying moisture, broken grain percentage, and residue limits with safety margin.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Approve blend plan, monitor actual loading, record container seal, and lock the immutable compliance dossier.

landing.complianceNotice: GrainLedger follows the ISO 22095:2020 mass balance model. The system records proportional source contributions — it does not claim identity-preserved traceability after bulk silo mixing.
